description.value: The Clydesdale Inn is a three-storey hotel located in the Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley region of British Columbia. Its website is currently in maintenance mode, so details about rooms, services, and facilities are not publicly available. Touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley corridor may find it a useful overnight stop, pending confirmation of amenities.
